definitions.explanation: The side or area facing or located to the west. Used for physical orientation (the west side of a building, room, or area) and, in geopolitical contexts, for the Western bloc.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{西側|にしがわ}に{出口|でぐち}がある。
examples.english: There is an exit on the west side of the station.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{西側|にしがわ}は{夕方|ゆうがた}になると{暑|あつ}くなる。
examples.english: The west side of the room gets hot in the evening.

examples.japanese: {町|まち}の{西側|にしがわ}には{大|おお}きな{公園|こうえん}と{図書館|としょかん}がある。
examples.english: On the west side of town there is a large park and a library.

notes:
Compound of {西|にし} (west) + {側|がわ} (side). The same {側|がわ} pattern produces all four directional sides.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駅|えき}の{西側|にしがわ}: the west side of the station
- {西側|にしがわ}の{窓|まど}: a west-facing window
- {西側|にしがわ}{諸国|しょこく}: Western (bloc) nations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {東側|ひがしがわ}: east side
- {南側|みなみがわ}: south side
- {北側|きたがわ}: north side
